1. (Currently amended) A composition, comprising: cavity-generating particles; a thermally conductive binder; and a solvent, wherein the composition is formulated to create boiling nucleation sites when applied to a surface in contact with a liquid coolant.

2. (Currently amended) The composition of claim 1, wherein the composition is applied to an electronic component surface and forms a microporous coating with enhanced heat transfer properties.

3. (Currently amended) The composition of claim 2, wherein the solvent is removed during application to the electronic component surface, and the thermally conductive binder remains affixed to the surface.
